limitations: This fixes scheduled equity-market sessions from the officially published calendar, not proof that every symbol will trade or the provider will supply complete data.
Emergency market closures, individual suspensions, corporate actions, missing observations, and provider revisions must be recorded; do not silently replace dates or symbols.
JPX derivatives holiday trading is different and is not used for this cash-equity schedule.
GitHub Actions cron start time and provider finalization are not guaranteed by JPX market hours.
